title: Orchestral slate shim and capacity shepherd
creator: Sanjay Rao
description: Create a lightweight operational playbook ("Orchestral Slate Shim") and an associated staffing governance pattern ("Capacity Shepherd") to help PMs and Eng leads make fast, consistent scope and staffing decisions during a cycle. The goal is to reduce mid-cycle churn, make scope cuts defensible, and provide a standardized small buffer model that teams can opt into when facing constrained headcount or emergent work. This ticket covers the playbook draft, a short decision rubric, a templated capacity worksheet, and a 1-week pilot with two cross-functional teams.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Draft playbook written and reviewed by PM/Eng/Design with clear decision rubric for trimmed scope vs. deferred scope
A2: Capacity worksheet template (spreadsheet) created with sensible defaults (skill buckets, headroom %, core vs stretch items)
A3: Pilot run with 2 teams (Platform infra and Console) documented and at least one real scope decommit or swap executed using the rubric
A4: KPIs defined: mid-cycle descope time-to-decision < 48hrs, cycle on-plan variance reduced by 15% for pilot teams
A5: Playbook and template published to Confluence and linked from cycle planning page
